module.title: Reporting, Dashboards and Scheduled Distribution
module.business_purpose: A configuration-driven reporting engine so the application supports dynamic reports without code changes. Report definitions declare a governed dataset, parameters, columns and output formats; versions are tracked; schedules and subscriptions drive automated execution and distribution; executions capture parameters, row counts and the produced file; dashboards compose reports into visual surfaces. Reads only from governed read models (module 30) — never grants authority.
